patterns.note: Extensive use of full-bleed, high-quality photography and video, often arranged in large grids or hero sections, creating an immersive visual experience.

A strong typographic contrast between a modern, clean sans-serif for body text and UI elements, and an elegant, condensed serif for display headings and hero text, frequently using all caps for emphasis.
A predominantly monochrome palette of black, white, and dark grey, accented by natural skin tones and subtle pastel hues derived directly from product photography (e.g., light blue, muted peach).

The header transforms on scroll, shrinking the logo and navigation into a sticky bar. The hero video background exhibits a subtle parallax effect relative to the foreground text. A massive, bold brand logo is revealed as the final element in the footer upon reaching the bottom of the page.
Product categories are presented in a clean, equally-sized four-column grid, each with a large product image and category label.

technique_notes: The header transitions from a transparent overlay with a large logo to a smaller, solid background sticky navigation bar upon scroll. The hero video background scrolls at a slightly different rate than the foreground text, creating a subtle parallax effect. Sections below the hero appear to smoothly scroll into view, with a large, bold logo revealing itself as the final element in the footer, appearing from the bottom of the viewport, likely facilitated by a smooth scrolling library like locomotive-scroll.

Imagery is presented in full-bleed sections and grids, often featuring models in aspirational, active poses, creating a strong lifestyle brand narrative. Text overlays on images use a dark, semi-transparent background for contrast.
Typography combines a clean sans-serif for readability with a distinctive, elegant serif for display purposes, often using uppercase for impact and clear hierarchy.

design_tokens.type_scale: A clear hierarchy with a large, elegant serif for hero text (~3-4x body), strong sans-serif for section titles (~2x body), and a clean, readable sans-serif for body text and labels, with frequent use of uppercase for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp, with most elements and images featuring crisp, square corners, contributing to a modern and clean aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy, characterized by generous white space around sections and within content blocks, particularly in hero and editorial image grids, enhancing the premium and uncluttered feel.

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, full-bleed photography and video, combined with a massive, almost sculptural logo reveal in the footer. This creates a highly immersive and aspirational brand experience that prioritizes visual storytelling and a strong brand presence over dense information.
